name: Trade war & tariffs
value: US Section 301 tariff hike on China, EU expected
summary: US readies Section 301 tariff increases on China, the EU and over a dozen economies; rates and dates not yet disclosed
state: The US is preparing to announce tariff increases on China, the EU and more than a dozen other economies as soon as 24 Nov, to replace tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court, after a Section 301 inquiry into subsidised excess capacity (TT News, citing the Wall Street Journal). Rates, products and start dates were not disclosed and USTR declined to comment. Trump's 12 Nov threat to double tariffs on Mexico is also not in force. Major tariffs threatened between large economies keep Watch; Alert needs broad new tariffs in force with retaliation.
for_you: Importers and exporters trading with the US, China and the EU face uncertainty over costs and timing until rates are published. Changes to tariffs tend to feed through to prices and supply contracts over several months.
rubric_hit: Watch: new major tariffs threatened between large economies (US Section 301 hike on China, EU and others expected from 24 Nov); none yet in force

sources.title: TT News — U.S. readies tariff hike on China, EU goods
Quartz — U.S. preparing tariff hike on China, E.U. and 14 other nations

why: Tariffs raise prices, reroute supply chains and slow growth; escalation cycles hurt export-heavy economies like the UK's partners.
drivers: US tariff policy, retaliation, court rulings, trade deals, WTO disputes.

rubric.alert: Broad new tariffs in force with retaliation under way, or US average effective tariff rising sharply.
rubric.watch: New major tariffs announced or threatened between large economies.
rubric.normal: Tariff regime stable; no new major measures in the past two weeks.
